        x /= 10;
    }
    if (neg) s += '-';
    reverse(s.begin(), s.end());
    return s;

    int n = vars.size();
    vector<int> left, right;
    
    function<void(int, int)> dfs = [&](int idx, int cur) {
        if (idx == n / 2) {
            left.push_back((cur + base) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        dfs(idx + 1, cur);
        dfs(idx + 1, (cur + vars[idx]) % MOD);
    };
    
    dfs(0, 0);

        if (idx == n) {
            right.push_back(cur);
            return;
        }
        dfs2(idx + 1, cur);
        dfs2(idx + 1, (cur + vars[idx]) % MOD);
    };

        x /= 10;
    }
    if (neg) s += '-';
    reverse(s.begin(), s.end());
    return s;
}

void solve_by_split(const vector<int>& arr, int offset, i128& total) {
    int n = arr.size();
    vector<int> first_half, second_half;
    
    function<void(int, int)> traverse_first = [&](int idx, int cur) {
        if (idx == n / 2) {
            first_half.push_back((cur + offset) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        traverse_first(idx + 1, cur);
        traverse_first(idx + 1, (cur + arr[idx]) % MOD);
    };
    
    traverse_first(0, 0);
    
    function<void(int, int)> traverse_second = [&](int idx, int cur) {
        if (idx == n) {
            second_half.push_back(cur);
            return;
        }
        traverse_second(idx + 1, cur);
        traverse_second(idx + 1, (cur + arr[idx]) % MOD);
    };
    
    traverse_second(n / 2, 0);
    
    sort(first_half.begin(), first_half.end());
    sort(second_half.begin(), second_half.end());
    
    ll sum_second = 0;
    for (int x : second_half) sum_second = (sum_second + x) % MOD;
    
    int j = second_half.size() - 1;
    for (int x : first_half) {
        while (j >= 0 && x + second_half[j] >= MOD) --j;
        total += (ll)x * second_half.size() + sum_second - (ll)(second_half.size() - 1 - j) * MOD;
    }
}

ll ten_pow[17];

ll count_numbers(const string& prefix, ll limit, const string& n_str) {
    ll val = 0;
    for (char c : prefix) val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
    
    ll cnt = 0;
    int plen = prefix.size();
    int nlen = n_str.size();
    
    for (int len = plen; len <= nlen; ++len) {
        if (len < nlen) {
            cnt += ten_pow[len - plen];
        } else {
            if (prefix < n_str) {
                cnt += ten_pow[len - plen];
            } else if (prefix == n_str) {
                cnt += limit - val * ten_pow[nlen - plen] + 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return cnt;
}

    for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) ten_pow[i] = ten_pow[i-1] * 10;
    
    i128 result = 0;
    
    for (int num_len = 1; num_len <= (int)ns.size(); ++num_len) {

            ll cur_val = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < diff_pos; ++i) {
                cur_str += ns[i];
                cur_val = cur_val * 10 + (ns[i] - '0');
            }
            
            for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d) {
                if (diff_pos == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                if (diff_pos < (int)ns.size() && d == ns[diff_pos] - '0') continue;
                if (num_len == (int)ns.size() && d > ns[diff_pos] - '0') continue;
                
                string new_str = cur_str + char('0' + d);
                ll new_val = cur_val * 10 + d;
                
                ll base = 0;
                string tmp;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)new_str.size(); ++i) {
                    char start_char = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                    for (char c = start_char; c < new_str[i]; ++c) {
                        base += count_numbers(tmp + c, n, ns);
                    }
                    tmp += new_str[i];
                }
                base += (int)new_str.size() - 1;
                
                vector<int> vars;
                tmp = new_str;
                for (int i = new_str.size(); i < num_len; ++i) {
                    int cnt = count_numbers(tmp + '0', n, ns) % MOD;
                    vars.push_back(cnt);
                    tmp += '0';
                }
                
                base += 1;
                base -= new_val * ten_pow[num_len - new_str.size()];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)vars.size(); ++i) {
                    vars[(int)vars.size() - 1 - i] -= ten_pow[i] % MOD;
                }
                
                int b = base % MOD;
                if (b < 0) b += MOD;
                
                for (int& v : vars) {
                    v %= MOD;
                    if (v < 0) v += MOD;
                }
                
                solve_by_split(vars, b, result);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Handle exact prefixes
    string prefix;
    ll val = 0;
    for (int len = 1; len <= (int)ns.size(); ++len) {
        prefix += ns[len-1];
